supermarine_southampton.name: Supermarine Works, Woolston
supermarine_southampton.description: Primary Spitfire production on the River Itchen. Its destruction would severely curtail RAF fighter deliveries.

hawker_kingston.name: Hawker Aircraft, Kingston
hawker_kingston.description: Hurricane production facility south-west of London. Delivers the bulk of RAF Fighter Command's single-engine fighters.

bristol_filton.name: Bristol Aeroplane Co., Filton
bristol_filton.description: Produces Beaufighter and Blenheim aircraft and Bristol Hercules aero engines.

vickers_brooklands.name: Vickers-Armstrongs, Brooklands
vickers_brooklands.description: Wellington bomber and Spitfire sub-assembly production at Brooklands aerodrome.

rolls_royce_derby.name: Rolls-Royce, Derby
rolls_royce_derby.description: Sole source of the Merlin engine powering every Spitfire and Hurricane. Its destruction could cripple the entire RAF fighter force.

de_havilland_hatfield.name: de Havilland, Hatfield
de_havilland_hatfield.description: Tiger Moth, Oxford trainer and early Mosquito development. Important contribution to aircrew supply.

short_rochester.name: Short Brothers, Rochester
short_rochester.description: Stirling heavy bomber and Sunderland flying boat production on the Medway.

westland_yeovil.name: Westland Aircraft, Yeovil
westland_yeovil.description: Lysander and Whirlwind fighter production. Smaller output than the main Spitfire/Hurricane plants.

armstrong_coventry.name: Armstrong Siddeley, Coventry
armstrong_coventry.description: Aero-engine and aircraft component manufacture — one of the Midlands' key industrial centres.

portsmouth_dockyard.name: Portsmouth Royal Dockyard
portsmouth_dockyard.description: Royal Navy's principal southern base. Home to destroyers and cruisers defending the Channel.

thornycroft_southampton.name: Thornycroft Shipyard
thornycroft_southampton.description: Destroyer and torpedo boat construction vital to maintaining Royal Navy strength.

cammell_laird_birkenhead.name: Cammell Laird Shipyard
cammell_laird_birkenhead.description: One of Britain's largest shipyards, responsible for major warship construction and repair.

thameshaven_oil.name: Thames Haven Refinery
thameshaven_oil.description: Major petroleum storage and refinery serving London and south-east England.

shell_haven.name: Shell Haven Refinery
shell_haven.description: Shell petroleum storage and refining on the north bank of the Thames estuary.

avonmouth_oil.name: Avonmouth Oil Terminal
avonmouth_oil.description: Western approaches fuel depot serving Bristol and South Wales.

london_docks.name: London Docks
london_docks.description: Surrey and Royal Victoria Docks — Britain's largest port complex, handling the bulk of wartime imports.

tilbury_docks.name: Tilbury Docks
tilbury_docks.description: Major Thames estuary cargo port handling essential war supplies.

southampton_docks.name: Southampton Docks
southampton_docks.description: Premier passenger and military cargo port on the Solent.

mersey_docks.name: Mersey Docks, Liverpool
mersey_docks.description: Vital Atlantic convoy terminus. Severing this port would strangle Britain's western supply line.

clapham_junction.name: Clapham Junction
clapham_junction.description: Busiest railway junction in Britain, routing supplies, troops and equipment across southern England.

crewe_railway.name: Crewe Railway Works
crewe_railway.description: Major LMS junction and locomotive works linking the industrial north to the south.

battersea_power.name: Battersea Power Station
battersea_power.description: Coal-fired power station supplying electricity to central London and the Underground.
